title: Plural genitive: retained vowel + -jen
focus: Keep the final o, u, ö or y and add -jen in these short words: talo (“house”) → talojen.

exercises.prompt: Choose the plural genitive of talo (“house”).
exercises.explanation: Keep talo and add -jen: talo + jen = talojen.

optionFeedback.talojen: Keep talo and add -jen: talo + jen = talojen.
optionFeedback.talo: talo is the dictionary form; this question needs the plural genitive.
optionFeedback.talon: talon does not use the plural genitive stem and ending for talo.
